verdict.rationale: Orama's docs name official SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust for Orama Cloud, and the REST API page steers users to those SDKs. The open-source Orama JS library is documented in depth and ships for browser, CDN and Deno use. missing for 10: in-depth documentation evidence for the Python and Rust SDKs beyond a listing, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
